name: Methylethyltryptamine
summary: Methylethyltryptamine (MET), also known as N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine (N,N-MET), is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. It is taken orally or via inhalation.

pharmacology.text: MET is a serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor partial agonist. It shows very weak activity as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2B receptors. In addition to acting at the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, MET is a serotonin releasing agent with lower potency. It produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in animals.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent

uses.text: It is taken orally or via inhalation. The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2014.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelic tryptamines can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and raised blood pressure, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。迷幻色胺類可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快與血壓上升，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。迷幻色胺类可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快与血压上升，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: Methylethyltryptamine appeared as a designer drug in Europe in 2014. It is one of the simplest lopsided relatives of DMT, with a methyl on one side of its nitrogen and an ethyl on the other.
fact.zh: 甲基乙基色胺在2014年以設計藥物身分出現在歐洲。它是 DMT 最簡單的不對稱親戚之一，氮原子一側接甲基，另一側接乙基。
fact.zhHans: 甲基乙基色胺在2014年以设计药物身分出现在欧洲。它是 DMT 最简单的不对称亲戚之一，氮原子一侧接甲基，另一侧接乙基。
